key_concepts: Wind is the movement of air parallel to Earth's surface.
A wind vane tells wind direction.
A windsock shows both wind direction and wind speed.
Humidity is the amount of moisture in the air and is measured by a hygrometer.
Temperature is the degree of hotness or coldness of air and is measured by a thermometer.
